summary: CLAIM C-0003: Transport of materials to the site via Nile waterways is well-established (Merer papyrus + Ahramat branch).
content: Transport of materials to the site via Nile waterways is well-established. The Merer papyrus documents limestone blocks shipped by boat from Tura to Giza through artificial basins/canals (EV-0007, EV-0019). The 2024 Ahramat branch discovery confirms a 64km extinct Nile branch ran beside the pyramids, likely used for transport (EV-0009, EV-0018). This is the strongest-established part of the construction story.
